about: Files and helpers that hold or hand out secrets. secret-read-guard refuses any Bash, Read or Grep call that would print one of these; scripts/masked-read.py is the only sanctioned way to look at such a file. Data only: extend a list here, the guard and its tests read this file. `paths` are fnmatch patterns on the absolute path (`~` is $HOME; `*` also crosses `/`). `names` are fnmatch patterns on the basename and count only for an existing file, so a grep pattern word like auth.json is not mistaken for the file. `json_env_names` are secret only when the file is JSON with a non-empty top-level `env` block (Claude settings). Every entry also covers its backup copies: a basename ending in `backup_suffix_re` is matched with that suffix removed. `helpers` are commands whose stdout is a secret: running one is refused.
